decisions.decision: Q1 An activity page is one screen the author acts on: one survey question, one marks station, one gallery. Never one letter or key.
decisions.why: Row must not duplicate in-page letter navigation (FR-001, FR-033).

decisions.decision: Q2 The marks series contributes one mark per VISIBLE station, each individually addressable.
decisions.why: A never-raised station is a page the author never sees; 057 FR-049a forbids a greyed placeholder (FR-004, SC-003).

decisions.decision: Q3 Touch Gallery By-character / By-key is ONE activity page, one mark.
decisions.why: The modes are two views of one page; symmetric with Mechanisms (FR-005).
decisions.rejected: Two marks, one per view mode.

decisions.decision: Q4 A stage behind the author with work still owed renders HOLLOW; no fourth mark shape is added. The behind-vs-ahead distinction moves into the accessible name.
decisions.why: Keeps 057 three mark classes intact (FR-006, FR-008, FR-031).

decisions.decision: Q5 The nudge may name ONLY sections behind the author; the current section and any ahead are excluded.
decisions.why: The author is already in the current section and it carries its own in-page indicators (FR-017, FR-018).

decisions.decision: Q6 An incomplete keyboard IS downloadable (.kmp and .zip) after an explicit dismissible-to-safety complaint; publishing to the community repo MUST be refused with its own coverage term.
decisions.why: It compiles, so blocking download blocks the harmless action; publish is the consequential one (FR-023..FR-027, D-7).

decisions.decision: Q7 / A3 Mark-for-later DEFERS, it does not discharge: a marked letter keeps its section named by the nudge and its stage mark hollow. Marking relaxes only the gallery own completion control.
decisions.why: All letters must be handled at some point (FR-014). One-term flip if reversed.

decisions.decision: R1 The one outstanding-work derivation lives in lib/outstandingWork.ts (pure) with a hooks/useOutstandingWork.ts seam.
decisions.why: Mirrors the existing accountedForGate/useAccountedForGate idiom (FR-011) and is forced by the decisions-layer depcruise rule, which blocks decisions/ -> stores/ even for type-only imports, so progressDots must receive the result as an input.
decisions.rejected: Putting it in decisions/ (blocked by the layer rule) or hook-only (not purely unit-testable, which is how D-8 happened).

decisions.decision: R2 A passed section keeps a mark via a behind-position counterpart to aheadStageDot; hollow-behind is kind:upcoming plus a new ProgressDot.outstandingCount field.
decisions.why: The fallback branch already exists at progressDots.ts:642 and simply has nothing to call for a behind step. outstandingCount lets the accessible name branch on structure, satisfying FR-008 while ProgressDotKind stays a three-member union (FR-031, Q4).
decisions.rejected: A fourth ProgressDotKind (violates FR-031); inferring behind-ness from resolution.reason (resolveLocation returns reachable for a visited step either side of the cursor).

decisions.decision: R3 MarksSeriesStep publishes a within-step walk from its existing visibleStations array; no resolver change is needed.
decisions.why: The four station ids are already legal Location question segments, and liveResolveContext passes stepPositions from the walk store - the same path that makes gallery character tokens resolvable. Publishing the walk makes every station jumpable for free.
decisions.rejected: Promoting each station to a manifest step (reorders the manifest, out of scope) or registering them in questionRegistry (they are not survey questions).

decisions.decision: R4 StepWalkPosition gains required?: boolean where ABSENT MEANS NOT REQUIRED; galleries and marks stations publish required:true explicitly.
decisions.why: Absent-means-required would make every existing publisher instantly report work the author does not owe - the same dishonesty this feature removes. A flow gates its own advance, so a section cannot be behind the author with a required question unanswered.
decisions.rejected: Deriving required-ness from questionRegistry (no such field, and it would move the declaration off the owning surface, against FR-007).

decisions.decision: R5 FR-013 is satisfied by SOURCING coverage from useInventoryCoverageGate, not by new persistence.
decisions.why: That hook already reads phaseResults/touchLayoutJson/confirmedInventory from the working-copy store (the durable draft envelope), not the session-scoped walk store - so coverage is already reload-correct. This is also the real fix for D-3, whose galleries survive today only because clearStepWalk has no production caller.
decisions.rejected: Persisting walks into the draft envelope (explicitly out of scope); a no-walk-means-unknown branch (a second notion of completeness, forbidden by FR-009).

decisions.decision: R6 jumpToStep and backToUnfinishedGallery collapse into ONE section-id-taking backward-landing action that jumpToLocation calls.
decisions.why: FR-019 requires generalizing the primitive rather than adding a second nav path. It also fixes a latent bug: visited is what resolveLocation gates on, so a target in visited but absent from history resolves reachable and jumpToLocation reports arrived while jumpToStep silently no-ops.
decisions.rejected: Letting the nudge call backToUnfinishedGallery directly (leaves D-6 unfixed - no resolution, no refusal reason); adding a third action.

decisions.decision: R7 Remove exactly one term (!coverageGate.blocked) from canDownload and give publish its own canPublish coverage term; relax all four arrival refusals; reuse editors/assignLoop/parts/ConfirmDialog for the complaint.
decisions.why: OutputScreen.tsx:715 passes canSubmit={canDownload}, so publish borrows downloads coverage term - relaxing download alone would silently open publish (D-7, FR-027). ConfirmDialog already documents Escape/backdrop = cancel, which is FR-025 exactly.
decisions.rejected: A boolean bypass beside the shared flag (FR-027 rules it out by name); a bespoke modal; relaxing only the button and leaving arrival blocked (screen unreachable).

decisions.decision: R8 Pin the row with an exact-ordered-match test against the real manifest and replace the shell-level assertion.
decisions.why: StudioShell.test.tsx:2614 asserts dot count toBeGreaterThan(0) - it passes with a single mark, which IS the reported defect. SC-008 requires exact match, not a subset or minimum.
decisions.rejected: A snapshot test, which absorbs a regression on update.

approach: One new pure derivation (lib/outstandingWork.ts) plus a hooks/useOutstandingWork.ts seam - the existing accountedForGate/useAccountedForGate idiom - consumed by both the footer row and the top-bar nudge so the two cannot disagree. Three existing mechanisms are extended rather than forked: progressDots.ts gains a behind-the-author section mark, MarksSeriesStep starts publishing a walk of its visible stations (which makes them Location-addressable for free via ctx.stepPositions), and jumpToStep/backToUnfinishedGallery collapse into one section-id-taking primitive. On output, the coverage term moves off canDownload onto an independently-derived canPublish, and the four arrival refusals become warnings.

plan.summary: Plan + research + data-model + UI contract written for 061; all eight spec-observed defects traced to concrete code, no constitution violations.
plan.key_finding: OutputScreen.tsx:715 passes canSubmit={canDownload} - publish has no coverage term of its own, so relaxing the download gate as Q6 requires would silently make an incomplete keyboard publishable. That single line is the whole of D-7 and the reason FR-027 demands a test asserting publish stays refused while download is permitted.

tasks.summary: 41 tasks in 6 phases (Setup 2, Foundational 5, US1 9, US2 10, US3 9, Polish 6), laid out as 18 waves with explicit join points; all 35 FRs and 8 SCs mapped to tasks.
tasks.key_finding: Two tasks are hard ordering constraints rather than conveniences: T017 (collapse jumpToStep + backToUnfinishedGallery into one section-id-taking primitive) must land before T022 (the nudge), or D-6 is reintroduced for the duration of a commit; and T027 (canPublish with its own coverage term) must land before T031 flips canSubmit off canDownload, since that one line at OutputScreen.tsx:715 is the whole of D-7.

FR-001.title: One mark per activity page; never per letter, per key, or per gallery view mode.

FR-002.title: A section the author has passed must keep a mark, even when it records no survey answer and publishes no walk.

FR-003.title: A section the path bypassed has no mark at all - absence, never a greyed placeholder.

FR-004.title: The marks series contributes one mark per visible station, each addressable, restoring to the named station on arrival.

FR-005.title: Each gallery contributes exactly one mark, whatever the inventory size and whichever view mode is active.

FR-006.title: A behind-the-author mark reads complete when the section owes nothing and outstanding when it does.

FR-007.title: An optional unanswered question does not make its section outstanding; required-ness is declared by the owning surface.

FR-009.title: Exactly one derivation of what a section still owes, consumed by both the progress row and the nudge.

FR-010.title: Required work is uncovered inventory characters plus unanswered required questions; optional questions contribute nothing.

FR-011.title: The derivation is a pure function with a React composition seam beside it, following the existing gate idiom.

FR-012.title: Character coverage is read from the existing single coverage predicate, never forked or partially inlined.

FR-013.title: The derivation is correct on a restored draft: coverage comes from the working copy, not session-scoped walks.

FR-014.title: Marked-for-later characters still count as outstanding for the row and the nudge.

FR-015.title: Each outstanding section yields a Location so both consumers navigate through the one jump implementation.

FR-016.title: The pure module imports no dashboard layer and reads no stores directly.

FR-017.title: One top-bar nudge slot naming the earliest section behind the author that owes required work, with its count.

FR-018.title: The section the author stands in, and any section ahead, are never named by the nudge.

FR-019.title: Activating the nudge navigates through the same mechanism and refusal rules as a row mark; the backward primitive is generalized, not duplicated.

FR-020.title: A section is named identically in the nudge and in the row, from one shared label source.

FR-021.title: The nudge strings go through the catalog and take new ids, because the message meaning changed.

FR-022.title: With nothing owed the nudge is absent, not an empty or disabled slot.

FR-023.title: Incomplete character coverage does not block download of the .kmp or the .zip.

FR-024.title: Requesting an artifact with incomplete coverage first raises a complaint naming what is missing and offering both paths.

FR-025.title: Dismissing the complaint indirectly by Escape or backdrop takes the safe path and produces no artifact.

FR-026.title: Submitting to the community repository is refused while required letters are missing, and states that reason.

FR-027.title: The publish refusal has its own coverage term, not derived from the download gate, pinned by a test.

FR-028.title: The author can reach the Output screen with incomplete coverage; every arrival gate becomes a warning.

FR-029.title: The coverage banner stays loud and specific, reworded to say download is possible and submission is not.

FR-030.title: No other emission gate is relaxed: compile readiness, instantiation, attribution, licence, and stale-touch all stand.

FR-031.title: The three existing mark classes and their shapes are unchanged; no fourth shape is introduced.

FR-032.title: Row overflow behaviour is unchanged and the footer height does not grow.

FR-033.title: Per-letter addressing does not return to the row; the in-page character strip stays the affordance.

FR-035.title: The coverage predicate fail-closed behaviour on a corrupted touch layout, including disregarding marked letters, is preserved.

FR-008.title: Outstanding-behind and not-yet-reached share a shape, so they must not share an accessible name.

SC-001.title: Sections represented in the row equals the manifest sections on the path up to the current gallery - none missing, none duplicated.

SC-002.title: No mark in the row is ever addressed to a single letter, at any inventory size.

SC-003.title: A marks series raising n visible stations contributes exactly n marks, for n from one to four.

SC-004.title: A section left with required work outstanding reads outstanding rather than complete, including after a full page reload.

SC-005.title: With work outstanding in more than one passed section, exactly one nudge is shown and it names the manifest-earliest.

SC-006.title: With incomplete coverage both artifacts download after an explicit acknowledgement and submission is refused, same screen and session.

SC-007.title: The footer height is unchanged and the current-position mark stays visible without manual scrolling at the narrowest width.

SC-008.title: The row composition is pinned by an exact-match test against the real manifest, not a subset matcher and not a minimum count.
